set -uo pipefail
for tool in git bash sh python3 make grep sed awk find sort fish node jq rsync cmp sha256sum realpath head cut tr; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 20
done
make build >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 21
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue
  first_line="$(head -n1 "$file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [[ "$first_line" =~ (^|/)(sh)([[:space:]]|$) ]] && [[ "$first_line" != *bash* ]]; then interpreter=sh; else interpreter=bash; fi
  marker="$(grep -n -m1 '^### DATA ###$' "$file" | cut -d: -f1 || true)"
  if [[ -z "$marker" ]]; then
    "$interpreter" -n "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 22
  else
    head -n "$((marker - 1))" "$file" | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*exit([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 22
    tmp="$(mktemp)"
    head -n "$((marker - 1))" "$file" >"$tmp"
    "$interpreter" -n "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f "$tmp"; exit 22; }
    rm -f "$tmp"
  fi
done < <(git ls-files -z -- '*.sh' '*.install' 'setup' 'scripts/inir' '*/PKGBUILD' 'assets/helpers/inir-battery-charge-limit' 'assets/helpers/inir-thinkfan')
python3 - <<'PY' >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 23
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
raw=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","-z","--","*.py"])
for name in raw.decode().split("\0"):
    if name: compile(Path(name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),name,"exec")
PY
python3 - <<'PY' >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 24
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
raw=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","-z","--","*.json"])
for name in raw.decode().split("\0"):
    if name: json.loads(Path(name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
PY
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do

done < <(git ls-files -z -- '*.js')

exit 0
